source: compute_inverse_density: float inputs rd/cv/cp/p1000, double scalar coeff=rd/p1000 and exponent=-cv/cp, then coeff*theta*pow(pressure/p1000, exponent). Wrapped C++ double scalars do not promote tensor dtype.
Caller uses th_base_, p_base_, rd_,cv_,cp_,100000.f; 100000 reference must not be conflated with separate EOS p0.
calc_p_rho_wrf promotes tensor inputs to double then computes native arithmetic, pow and output cast; preserve source order for interpretation.

propagation.conditions: D is bounded away from zero and widened alpha interval positive; theta, rd, p0, cp, cv and power base strictly positive; all fixed captured arguments and shape/dtypes proven.
propagation.bounds: |delta alpha| <= |beta/D| E_alb; |delta alpha_pert| <= |c1*mu/D| E_alb; pressure endpoint MPFR intervals or |dp/dalpha|=kappa*p/alpha with kappa=cp/cv>0 on widened alpha range.

minimum_method: At preserved same-call th_base/p_base and EOS args, build directed MPFR exact-real composed alb* then alpha/al_pert/p_pert interval and compare against captured native EOS outputs cellwise (if output exists); corroborate beta/D and positivity. Model scalar rounding separately if comparing to a native-intermediate reference, and do not assume libtorch pow ULP.
limits: MPFR interval trust and input identity assumptions explicit; other input formation and upstream base field uncertainty excluded.
Do not infer widened alpha domain from prior fixed-alb domain without revalidation.
EOS output Pa or alpha is not a bound on full RHS, scaled residual RMS, e0/e1 or merit descent; downstream propagation remains open.
Read-only source/math review; no tests, native or code edits.
